A. Definitions *
*The definitions below are invented for this test and
run on for a second line.

"Lamp network" means a list of lamp keepers under contract.
"Lessee" means a person that leases a lamp network.

B. Lamp Network Contracting Act
Section I. Leasing
A. A keeper may lease a lamp network only under [cite lamp code].
[Drafting Note: An invented bracketed note
that runs over two lines.]
B. A lessee shall give notice of each lease.
Section II. Penalties
Drafting Note: A state may set its own penalties here.

Section III. {Severability clause}
Section IV. Notice
A lessee shall post notice of each lease.
